description.text: Studying period: The first week of November - December. (at least 4 weeks) Hours per week: 30 (45min/1class hour), 4 class hours in the morning and 2 class hours in the afternoon. Courses: Chinese reading and writing, Spoken Chinese Textbooks: 40 Lessons for Basic Chinese Course (the first volumn); Crash Spoken Chinese (beginner). Studying objective: After 8 weeks study, applicants can grasp the Chinese pronunciation and basic sentence patterns. With 1200 new words mastered, students can chat with Chinese people about daily topics. Tuition fees: The course will be opened at least 15 students. Those who want to join the class during the course will not be accepted. RMB 2500 for the first four weeks in total and RMB 500 will be added for each additional week.

duration.text: The Short-term Advanced Chinese Program at Shanghai University is a 8 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 625 USD/In total ￥ 4500 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: Applicants should have achieved elementary Chinese level or HSK B or above. Aged 18 to 60, with foreign passport.
